name: Windy
description: The wind helps one way, then the other.
_help: Platformer, brawler and racer (in the racer you always ride right, so the wind is behind you or in your face). wind: how much faster you move with the wind and slower against it (0.25 = 25%), on the ground and in the air, so jumps go further with it and shorter against it; jump height never changes. windEvery: seconds between swaps (the HUD blinks for the last second). The wind starts blowing left. levels: settings for level 2 and 3, picked at the machine.

levels.description: A gale that keeps turning. x1.5.
